prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Adding wait-step status indicators (+14.7% measured) and diagnostic screens (+6.1% measured) were helpful; predictions (+14.0% and +3.5%) were slightly too low.
Other new screens and wait-info additions (such as verification/test screens and validation checklists) showed no clear effect.
Deferring account sign-in significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), and the prediction (+15.0%) was far too high.
Path outcome copy optimization significantly harmed performance (-6.6%), while other copy refinements showed no clear effect; predictions were generally too high.
Hints, callouts, redesigns, and layout changes showed no clear effect; predictions (+1.0% to +12.0%) were consistently too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +3.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, wait_info: +9.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -3.4% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -2.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +2.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +8.6% over 1 test(s)
- home, hint: +0.7% over 1 test(s)
- home, new_screen: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- home, redesign: +4.1% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.7% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.5% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Path Discovery Layout: Redesigns the path selection screen into a story_scroll layout that blends narrative context directly with companion path selection. (why: Path selection drops off to 76.2% with a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate when choosing their path.)
1: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Tip Carousel: Adds an auto-rotating tip carousel component to the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Lessons showed status and wait indicators increased completion (+14.7%), while mean time on home/waiting step remains high (2336s).)
2: [sign_in, copy] Account Restoration Clarification Headline: Updates sign-in headline and body text to clearly state that signing in restores existing pets and prevents loss. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
3: [home, notification] Background Pet Generation System Notification: Enables native background notifications when pet generation completes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s (over 38 minutes), indicating users minimize the app and forget to return.)
4: [finish, hint] Tray Menu Quick Access Hint: Adds a hint callout on the home intro screen detailing how to hide, show, and summon pet controls via the system tray. (why: Support received multiple inquiries regarding how to control or hide the pet, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split Layout Adoption Certificate Confirmation: Changes adoption certificate screen to a split layout displaying pet details on one side and adoption confirmation on the other. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 68.2% and exhibits high mean completion times (1017s).)

scores.note: Redesigns and layout changes on choose_path historically showed no clear effect or negative results.
Wait-info and progress updates consistently perform well on steps with long wait times.
Strong evidence from support emails and funnel dropoff, though copy changes yield modest gains.
Addresses long wait times via system notifications, though requires native release work.
High dropoff and support inquiries point here, but hint callouts historically show minimal impact.
Target step drops 31.8% of users, but layout restructuring requires screen updates with mild expected lift.
